about: server/setup/estimate.py pins its formula here; the dashboard's TypeScript copy must give every `expect` from `model` and `selection` (each number within 0.01, the rest equal; `fits` compares the figures rounded to 0.01) and refuse every `error` case with that status and code. `model` is the part of the model payload (GET /v1/setup/models/{id}) the formula reads. Regenerate with python tests/test_setup_estimate.py --write after a registry change.
